programme.desc: Naomie Harris and Natalie Dormer star in this thriller about two estranged friends who unveil a deceptive plot that changes everything.

programme.title: The Cinema List: Antiheroes
programme.desc: From Dirty Harry and The Godfather to the deeply imperfect gang from the Fast and the Furious franchise, this Cinema List celebrates our favourite anti-heroes.

programme.title: Marlowe
programme.desc: Liam Neeson stars as lonely, 1930s private detective Philip Marlowe as he sets out to unravel a mystery at Diane Kruger's behest. Neo-noir Sky Original thriller.

programme.title: Vertigo
programme.desc: James Stewart is the detective with a fear of heights driven over the edge by icy blonde Kim Novak. Alfred Hitchcock's dizzying tale of obsession and intrigue.

programme.title: Trap
programme.desc: The latest mystery thriller by M Night Shyamalan sees a father and his teen daughter attend a deadly pop concert. With Josh Harnett.

programme.title: Ocean's Twelve
programme.desc: George Clooney reassembles his team of conmen and heads to Europe to pull off a series of daring heists. Julia Roberts and Brad Pitt also star.

programme.title: The Accountant
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Ben Affleck as a high-functioning autistic number-cruncher who moonlights as a money launderer for the mob. With Anna Kendrick and JK Simmons.

programme.title: Clear And Present Danger
programme.desc: CIA man Harrison Ford is double-crossed and becomes mixed up in an illegal war on a Colombian drug ring. Strong language/violence/flashing images.

programme.title: The Sum Of All Fears
programme.desc: Ben Affleck stars as CIA agent Jack Ryan, who races to avert nuclear war after a terrorist gets his hands on a missing bomb. Tom Clancy thriller with Morgan Freeman.

programme.title: Psycho
programme.desc: A thief checks into a secluded motel. Watch Alfred Hitchcock's iconic thriller at no extra cost thanks to Sky VIP using the Sky Store app. Ends 05/11/2023. Violence.

programme.title: The Island
programme.desc: Scarlett Johansson and Ewan McGregor try to outrun the government after discovering the truth about a utopian society. Futuristic thriller. Contains flashing images.

programme.title: Ocean's Thirteen
programme.desc: George Clooney, Brad Pitt and Matt Damon plot a Vegas swindle when scheming casino boss Al Pacino uses dirty money to open a new gambling joint. Stylish sequel.

programme.title: The Last Stop In Yuma County
programme.desc: While stranded at a rural Arizona rest stop, a travelling salesman and a waitress is thrust into a hostage situation when two bank robbers hide out there after a heist.

programme.title: Along Came A Spider
programme.desc: Still recovering from his partner's death, forensic psychologist Morgan Freeman reluctantly returns to the job to hunt a killer. Strong language/violence/flashing images.

programme.title: Every Breath You Take
programme.desc: A psychiatrist's life gets turned upside down when a patient takes her own life. Sky Original film with Sam Claflin.
